text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a person, an animal or an object. Another key task is object detection, where the computer finds and locates several objects in the same image. Computer vision has many useful applications in our daily lives. For example, it is used in security cameras, medical imaging and shopping apps. One of the most exciting applications is self-driving cars, which use computer vision to see the road, recognise traffic signs and detect pedestrians and other vehicles.
